author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The DFRobot seeMote Cube is a handheld spatial input device for Apple Vision Pro application development. The 56mm cube combines six-degree-of-freedom tracking, six programmable buttons, Bluetooth connectivity, and app-controlled haptic feedback for interacting with virtual objects and tools in visionOS. title: DFRobot seeMote Cube tracks motion and sends haptic feedback in visionOS
